imperium.name: The Ardent Imperium
imperium.summary: The Empire itself: forty provinces, six client kingdoms and nine centuries of unbroken Valerran rule from the capital, Caelora. At the height of its power, wealthy, ordered and confident.

seravel.name: Kingdom of Seravel
seravel.summary: Your kingdom. A prosperous river kingdom on the western frontier, rich in grain, timber and river trade along the Sera. Loyal for two centuries, rarely noticed, never quite trusted with more.

lucerna.name: Kingdom of Lucerna
lucerna.summary: The oldest human client kingdom, bound to the dynasty by marriage. Its kings are the Emperor's cousins, and they act like it. Lucerna controls the lower Sera and wants the upper river too.

khar_dumeth.name: Khar-Dumeth
khar_dumeth.summary: The largest Kharad kingdom, a highland realm of basalt fortresses whose levies form the core of the auxiliary legions. Conquered within living memory of its elders.

tor_ilun.name: Tor-Ilun
tor_ilun.summary: A Kharad steppe kingdom that joined the Empire by treaty rather than defeat. Its young queen is pushing reforms that its old clans distrust and its neighbour Khar-Dumeth resents.

velithra.name: Velithra
velithra.summary: The richest of the Veyari coastal leagues, a kingdom of harbours, counting-houses and archives. Velithra lends money to half the court and remembers every debt.

karst_odun.name: Karst Odun
karst_odun.summary: The Othari mountain kingdom whose mines feed the imperial mints. Its output is vast, and so are its debts to the treasury.
